subject.title: fix(agents): write unresumable notice to transcript for non-deliverable channels

question: Should non-deliverable WebChat restart-recovery failures be represented as persistent delivery-mirror assistant rows in the session transcript?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but this changes the durable session-history contract for failed restart recovery and should be an explicit maintainer choice rather than an automated merge assumption.

options.title: Accept The Guarded Transcript Fallback
options.body: Land this PR as the scoped WebChat notice fix while leaving broader recovery redesign work separate.

options.title: Request Live WebChat Proof First
options.body: Ask for a short Control UI restart/reconnect capture before accepting the transcript contract.

options.title: Defer To Broader Recovery Design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want restart deferral, immediate user-message persistence, or SQLite recovery routes to define the durable behavior first.

recommendation.title: Accept The Guarded Transcript Fallback
recommendation.body: Land this PR as the scoped WebChat notice fix while leaving broader recovery redesign work separate.
